limitations: All three start from the same actual V2 actor/Adam history, which includes earlier grounded training. NoSpeech measures this incremental stage without teacher requests; it is not a language-naive brain.
Scripted teacher; no real model inference is attempted.
Fresh real cohorts with retained actor/Adam; no same-individual private-state optimizer rebase.
Raw collector trace retains its legacy labels for provenance; only effective-native-training-targets.jsonl.zst describes the actual offline supervision used here.
Payload content is supervised only after actual completed activity; native action choice learns whether to vocalize. Wrong/unsolicited utterances count as failures, not competence.
This bounded experiment requires representative-only vocal arbitration; it cannot silently apply to an enabled conditional vocal sampler.
Two contact-first collections and relocated contact/near assessment, one shared RecoveryProtocol sleep ancestor per cue trio. No spontaneous sleep or far-navigation claim.
No equal-dose legacy-objective arm; objective and collection changes cannot be individually assigned all observed production gains.
Late exact activity descriptions are exploratory; the primary three eligible narration-row criterion remains unchanged.
NoSpeech retains the common source history and truthful offline activity/payload labels; only teacher request speech is absent.

actual_world_utterance_timing.method: Count actual emitted world receipts and native Vocal payload act-kind; compare with the predefined three eligible narration rows and, separately, the latest earlier real completed activity in the same cue fork.
